Subject: Re: Spike in response times — checkout (FastBuy)

Initial triage: we've confirmed elevated tail latency on the gen-api path used by FastBuy's checkout route. Observations so far:
- p95 jumped from ~80ms -> ~1.3s starting ~07:58 PDT; p99s at ~2.8s.
- QPS reports show a backlog forming on the embedding downstream service (third-party) which is causing request queues to grow on our runtime; memory pressure on some hosts triggered KV-cache evictions, increasing full-model recompute.
- No config rollouts from Redwood in the last hour; we see increased retries from the embedding layer.

Short-term mitigations under consideration (risk/benefit):
1) Apply a temporary routing override to move FastBuy traffic to a higher-priority pool (burst capacity) for 30 minutes — requires product/lead approval (affects shared pool quotas).
2) Enable relaxed KV-cache eviction thresholds for FastBuy's tenant to avoid recompute on hot prefixes — low risk but increases memory per-tenant for the window.
3) Apply conservative rate-limiting on long-running endpoints at the FastBuy side (customer action).

Requesting Karthik to confirm feasibility/timelines for #1 and #2. If approved, I'll prepare a short rollback play and schedule the toggle. Posting details to INC-4721 now.

-Soojin
Senior SRE | Redwood Inference

Subject: FastBuy: interim remediation and next steps (update)

Hi Sanjay / Alicia — quick update from the team.

What happened (short): our telemetry shows a downstream embedding service backlog that indirectly increased work per-request in the Redwood runtime, causing elevated tail latency and a throughput collapse for a subset of FastBuy checkout traffic. No code changes on Redwood were deployed that correlate with the start time.

What we did (immediate): with customer approval we flipped a temporary burst routing toggle that moves FastBuy to a higher-throughput pool and relaxed the tenant KV-cache eviction threshold. These actions restored QPS toward normal (~1.9k) and brought p95 back under 250ms within ~7 minutes of the toggle.

Next steps:
- FastBuy ops: please consider a conservative client-side rate cap for high-concurrency endpoints while embedding provider backlog clears (we can assist with recommended values).
- Redwood: Soojin and Karthik will monitor INC-4721 for 60 minutes and prepare a short RCA once the embedding provider stabilizes.
- Follow-up: we'll send a consolidated incident summary (RCA + timeline + mitigations) by EOD today.

We apologize for the disruption. I'll stay on the thread while we observe recovery — reach out if anything changes.

Best,
